kindNotes: modal.history.year: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.slice-end.record: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

hud.status-pill.market.data: the market town's pill a season after the proclamation: date, population, food, coin, the way back to town

hud.status-pill.market-years.data: the pill four years on: the slice ended, the treasury nearly doubled

hud.season-band.market.data: the market town's season close after the proclamation: the band of what changed in it (after a load: the people, the treasury, the steward's)

slot.population.growth.market.data: four years after the proclamation, a stop held: what holds the town's growth — the cause, since when (unknown after a load), the lord's lever

slot.population.growth-next.market.data: four years after the proclamation, no stop seen yet: what holds the town's next step, headed so, no since (LS1-6, A4)

hud.event-card.growth.market.data: the market town, a stop held: the chip when the stop is first said — its cause, since when, the lever, the way to the panel

hud.event-card.family-born.data: a child of the lord's house born at the year's turn: its name, the season, its parents

hud.event-card.family-died.data: a death in the lord's family: the ledger's sentence, the spouse left, the way to the chronicle

hud.event-card.family-married.data: a marriage in the lord's family: the two by name, the ledger's sentence, the way to the chronicle

modal.year-review.lord.data: 1300's card on the engine's yearReview after a load (unseen): the lord's decisions, the steward's, what followed by decision, the town

modal.history.year.data: 1300's year card to the chronicle: the records of 1300 only (both year selects on it)

modal.slice-end.data: the slice's end in 1317 (seed 3, five years after the second estate of 1312; ~/fls-slice-end-states rebuilt on the TRACE-KEEP engine): the last year 1316 at the top with its two cards as links, why and when, then and now with the maps, the decisions ranked by what followed, who remembers, a line a year with its big decisions from the thread (1300-1308 too) and what followed each, and its small matters counted in one line

modal.slice-end.record.data: the end page's first decision (1300's market dues, 67 rows followed) opened in the chronicle on its record (closing it comes back to the page)

modal.slice-end.year-card.data: 1316's year card (the last year; the slice ends in 1317 spring by its second estate) opened from the end page's link (the engine's yearReview)

modal.slice-end.season-card.data: 1316 winter's season card (the last closed before the end in 1317 spring) opened from the end page's link (it does not open by itself at the end)
